description: Four supplier quotes for MV Aegean Star (IMO 9000001, Piraeus -> Rotterdam, passing Gibraltar), written the way bunker traders write. 'Simulate supplier quotes' on the Bunkering page drops all four into the inbox at once (received now, so the quote-validity countdowns are live) and runs them through the pipeline. 'expected' is what the parser must extract; apps/api/src/llm/__tests__/demoQuotes.test.ts checks it.

emails.title: The trap: lowest price per tonne
emails.whatItTests: Cheapest on paper (USD 526/mt), but barging is USD 4,500 extra and the barge comes 12 h after arrival, from a supplier with a weak record. Should rank last on total cost.
emails.subject: MV AEGEAN STAR / GIB / VLSFO OFFER
emails.body:
Gd day,

Ref yr enq for MV Aegean Star (IMO 9000001) - ETA Gib on passage to Rotterdam.

Pls find our best offer, subj stem:

VLSFO 0.5% (ISO 8217:2017 RMG380) 750-1,000 mt @ USD 526/mt ex-barge
Barging: USD 4,500 l/s for Buyers acct
Delivery: b/d ETA+12 hrs subj barge avail
Pmt: 30 days from b/d
Firm 60 mins.

Brgds,
Rock Marine Fuels

emails.title: The balanced offer: all-in, prompt, reliable
emails.whatItTests: USD 5/mt dearer than the trap, but delivered (barging included), barge on arrival, 30 days credit and a supplier we trust. Should come out best on total cost.
emails.subject: RE: ENQ MV AEGEAN STAR - ALGECIRAS - VLSFO
emails.body:
Dear Sirs,

Tks for the enq. For MV Aegean Star (IMO 9000001) we offer firm, subj stem:

VLSFO 0.5% ISO 8217:2017, 750-1,000 mt @ USD 531/mt delivered Algeciras (ESALG), barging incl.
Delivery prompt, barge alongside on vsl's arrival.
Pmt 30 days net from b/d.
Offer firm 2 hrs.

Best regards,
Strait Bunkering Ltd

emails.title: The urgent one: good price, firm for 10 minutes
emails.whatItTests: USD 527/mt delivered, but only firm for 10 minutes (the UI counts down and warns) and on 15 days credit instead of 30, with a 2 h barge wait.
emails.subject: URGENT // MV AEGEAN STAR // VLSFO CEUTA - FIRM 10 MINS
emails.body:
Hi team,

b/d ETA+2 hrs.

emails.title: The messy one: two grades in one line
emails.whatItTests: Lower-case, no ship prefix, 'pmt' meaning both 'per metric ton' and 'payment', and VLSFO + LSMGO quoted in the same line. The parser must keep the two grades apart and pick up the overtime charge.
